title: Reaching More Customers with Facebook Ads - Groomer to Groomer

facts.fact: The author states that Facebook offers a dozen campaign objective options for paid ads.
facts.quote: Facebook offers a dozen options to choose from when designating your campaign objective.

facts.fact: The author states that there are 11 campaign options other than the one that is primary to creating paid Facebook advertisements.
facts.quote: There are 11 other campaign options available for business owners to create paid advertisements through Facebook.

facts.fact: According to the author, Facebook ad targeting by age can range from 13 to 65+.
facts.quote: Here you have the option of targeting user groups from age 13 to 65+.

facts.fact: The author states that when budgets are limited and audiences are very broad, ad frequency is typically low, with users seeing an ad less than 1.5 times on average.
facts.quote: this means that the number of times users see your ad will be very low (typically less than 1.5).
